0022600219.text: Boston comes in as the away side at 8-2, second in the East and 0.5 games back of first in the Atlantic, with a 3-2 road record and a three-game winning streak. Toronto is 5-5 and sixth in the East after a one-game losing streak, and it is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), while Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The Celtics won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 115-101 in Boston on April 5, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season.
